target.title: fix: keep text tool results ahead of stale media placeholders
target.body:
Closes #99241

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users reading text-only tool output could see or receive model responses based on media-placeholder text such as `(see attached image)` when a replayed or transformed tool result carried stale image/media blocks alongside the real text.

The affected workflow is agent/provider-bound handling of tool results during transcript replay, compaction, and provider message conversion. The visible symptom is that a plain text tool result can be misrepresented to the model as an image placeholder.

## Why This Change Was Made

Explicit text in a `toolResult` now wins over stale media blocks across provider transforms. Media placeholder fallback is reserved for media-only tool results, while mixed text/media tool results preserve the text and suppress stale image/audio placeholders.

This PR is intentionally limited to the minimal functional fix and regression coverage. It does not include the optional default-off diagnostic tracing used during local investigation.

AI-assisted: prepared with OpenClaw subagents and reviewed manually before submission.

## User Impact

Users can expect plain text tool results to remain visible to the model as text, even if replay or provider conversion encounters stale media blocks from adjacent tool output. Media-only tool results continue to use the existing placeholder behavior for providers that cannot consume the original media.

Operators get a narrower, provider-level fix without a Control UI change, config change, migration, or new runtime option.

## Evidence

- Focused regression tests via the repository wrapper:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/llm/providers/openai-responses-shared.test.ts src/llm/providers/tool-result-text.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts src/llm/providers/anthropic.test.ts src/llm/providers/google-shared.convert.test.ts extensions/google/transport-stream.test.ts src/llm/providers/mistral.test.ts src/llm/providers/openai-completions.test.ts`
  - Result: 9 files passed, 582 tests passed
- Type test gate:
  - `pnpm check:test-types`
  - Result: passed
- Diff sanity:
  - `git diff --check origin/main..HEAD`
  - Result: passed
  - Current branch is based on `origin/main` and contains one commit only.
- Local live validation after applying this patch to a running OpenClaw instance:
  - A post-upgrade `read` tool probe returned the expected plain text (`POST_UPGRADE_FILE_READ_PROBE_99241_748`) and did not appear as a media placeholder.
- Local review:
  - `codex review --base origin/main`
  - Result: no actionable correctness issues found in the changed provider conversions or shared tool-result media placeholder helper.
- Environment note:
  - `check:changed --staged` via the repository Crabbox/Testbox wrapper could not be used as final evidence because the local `crabbox` binary self-check failed before running project checks; the focused Vitest wrapper and type gates above passed.
